result.statement: For independent cap-one X,Y,Z and nonzero a,b, Q=2aXY+bZ^2 has continuous density with norm at most (2+log(4|a|/|b|))/|a| for |b|<=4|a| and at most 4/sqrt(|ab|) for |b|>=4|a|. In particular |a|,|b|>=1 implies norm <=2+log4<3sqrt(2).
result.key_new_step: retain both I_y<=1 from probability normalization and I_y<=2sqrt(2|ay|/|b|) from the cap-one parabola preimage, then integrate their minimum by a second bathtub
result.continuity: proved for this exact branch only

partner_applied.partner_fact: exact finite rotated cap-one family proves C_*>=3sqrt(2)

unresolved_implication: The bare three-large-eigenvalue hypothesis does not force an exact null-pair-plus-square physical principal block. Near-null perturbations, fully coupled three-macroscopic-row blocks, and interacting extra spectrum remain possible witness/proof mechanisms.
next_step: Quantify stability of the improved bound under near-null diagonal/coupling perturbations, or construct/analyze a fully coupled three-heavy exact cap-one stress family not reducible to a null pair.
